rules.rule: Flag hardcoded user-facing string literals in platform-ui and platform-reader Kotlin source under src/main. User-facing copy must use stringResource() or pluralStringResource() with keys synced from platform-localization. Authors should wire existing keys or add keys in platform-localization and sync strings_i18n.xml.

Reject direct edits to synced localization catalogs. User-facing strings are owned by platform-localization and synced into **/strings_i18n.xml and locale overlays (**/values-*/strings.xml). Feature PRs must not hand-edit these files; add keys in platform-localization and run the sync workflow instead.

AGENTS.md is an index of 100 lines or fewer. Flag a change that names a workflow file (the substring .yml), mentions CLAUDE.md, pastes localization policy instead of the single pointer to docs/localization-guardrails.md, or says platform-reader depends on both platform-core and platform-ui with api(). The split stays api() for platform-core and implementation for platform-ui.

platform-reader declares api(projects.platformCore) because BibleReader takes a BibleReference, and implementation(projects.platformUi) because platform-ui does not appear in public signatures. Flag a change that uses implementation for platform-core or api for platform-ui.

A grant cannot be revoked while the same user stays signed in. Flag a new clear of grantedPermissionValues outside the three existing sites: configure when !keepsStoredSession, saveAuthData when the tokens name a different session, and clearAuthData on sign-out.
